title: Potion or Coating Table
html:
The Potion or Coating Table, also known as Alchemy_PotionOrCoating , is a Treasure Table that contains both potions and coatings.

Drops

The following section can be transcluded into other pages with {{:Potion or Coating Table}}.

Item Quantity Chance
Potion Table 1 3/4
Coating Table 1 1/4
